meta.name: distributed-llm-pretraining-torchtitan
meta.description: Provides PyTorch-native distributed LLM pretraining using torchtitan with 4D parallelism (FSDP2, TP, PP, CP). Use when pretraining Llama 3.1, DeepSeek V3, or custom models at scale from 8 to 512+ GPUs with Float8, torch.compile, and distributed checkpointing.

copy.tagline: 用PyTorch原生方式在大规模GPU集群上预训练大语言模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要从零开始训练或微调Llama、DeepSeek等大模型
copy.tagline_en: Pretrain large language models at scale using native PyTorch on multi-GPU clusters
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to pretrain or fine-tune large models like Llama or DeepSeek from scratch

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以指导你使用 torchtitan 在 PyTorch 中预训练大语言模型，包括配置并行策略、启动训练、监控和恢复检查点。
howto.when: 当你需要从零预训练 Llama 3.1、DeepSeek V3 等模型，或使用 4D 并行（FSDP2、TP、PP、CP）在 8 到 512+ GPU 上训练时触发。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can guide you through pretraining large language models using torchtitan in PyTorch, including configuring parallelism strategies, launching training, monitoring, and resuming from checkpoints.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to pretrain models like Llama 3.1 or DeepSeek V3 from scratch, or use 4D parallelism (FSDP2, TP, PP, CP) on 8 to 512+ GPUs.
